# Shanhai Realm

Shanhai Realm (山海灵境) is a Chinese metaphysics AI companion for overseas Chinese and Chinese-speaking users. It provides CeZi Chinese character divination, I Ching-style readings, BaZi chart interpretation, daily fortune slips, and companion-style conversation for reflection around relationships, work, identity, and life uncertainty.

The product is for entertainment, inspiration, and emotional companionship only. It is not medical, legal, financial, investment, immigration, or professional advice.

## Suggested Summary

Shanhai Realm is an AI-assisted Chinese metaphysics app for overseas Chinese users. It helps users reflect on relationships, career choices, identity questions, and uncertainty through CeZi, I Ching, BaZi, daily oracle slips, and emotionally aware chat. Readings are symbolic and entertainment-focused, not guaranteed predictions or professional advice.
